package main

import (
	"bufio"
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"github.com/microsoft/TypeScript/tsc/shim/ast"
	"github.com/microsoft/TypeScript/tsc/shim/core"
	"github.com/microsoft/TypeScript/tsc/shim/parser"
	"github.com/microsoft/TypeScript/tsc/shim/tspath"
	"github.com/system-inc/cohere/internal/lint/rule"
	rules "github.com/system-inc/cohere/internal/lint/rules/typescript"
	"os"
	"sort"
	"strings"
	"unicode/utf16"
)

func written(text string) string {
	var result strings.Builder
	for _, r := range text {
		if r >= 32 && r <= 126 && r != '\\' {
			result.WriteRune(r)
		} else if r <= 65535 {
			fmt.Fprintf(&result, `\u%04x`, r)
		} else {
			h, l := utf16.EncodeRune(r)
			fmt.Fprintf(&result, `\u%04x\u%04x`, h, l)
		}
	}
	return result.String()
}
func main() {
	data, err := os.ReadFile(os.Args[1])
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	out := bufio.NewWriter(os.Stdout)
	defer out.Flush()
	countOnly := len(os.Args) > 2 && os.Args[2] == "--count"
	count, caseNumber := 0, 0
	for _, row := range strings.Split(string(data), "\n") {
		if row == "" {
			continue
		}
		fields := strings.Split(row, "\t")
		for len(fields) < 3 {
			fields = append(fields, "")
		}
		source, err := os.ReadFile(fields[0])
		if err != nil {
			panic(err)
		}
		path := fields[1]
		if path == "" {
			path = fields[0]
		}
		file := parser.ParseSourceFile(ast.SourceFileParseOptions{FileName: path, Path: tspath.Path(path)}, string(source), core.ScriptKindTS)
		if len(file.Diagnostics()) != 0 {
			panic(fmt.Sprintf("invalid source %s: %v", path, file.Diagnostics()))
		}
		subject := rules.NoImportTypeSideEffects
		var options any
		var ignored map[string]any
		_ = json.Unmarshal([]byte(fields[2]), &ignored)
		var diagnostics []rule.Diagnostic
		ctx := rule.Context{SourceFile: file, FileCache: rule.NewFileCache(), Report: func(d rule.Diagnostic) { diagnostics = append(diagnostics, d) }}
		listeners := subject.Run(ctx, options)
		var walk func(*ast.Node)
		walk = func(node *ast.Node) {
			if visit := listeners[node.Kind]; visit != nil {
				visit(node)
			}
			node.ForEachChild(func(child *ast.Node) bool { walk(child); return false })
		}
		walk(file.AsNode())
		sort.SliceStable(diagnostics, func(i, j int) bool { return diagnostics[i].Range.Pos() < diagnostics[j].Range.Pos() })
		count += len(diagnostics)
		if countOnly {
			continue
		}
		fmt.Fprintf(out, "case %d\n", caseNumber)
		caseNumber++
		var edits []rule.Fix
		for _, d := range diagnostics {
			fmt.Fprintf(out, "finding\t%d\t%d\t%s\t%s\n", d.Range.Pos(), d.Range.End(), d.Message.Id, written(d.Message.Description))
			for _, e := range d.Fixes {
				fmt.Fprintf(out, "fix\t%d\t%d\t%s\n", e.Range.Pos(), e.Range.End(), written(e.Text))
				edits = append(edits, e)
			}
			for _, s := range d.Suggestions {
				fmt.Fprintf(out, "suggestion\t%s\t%s\n", s.Message.Id, written(s.Message.Description))
				for _, e := range s.Fixes {
					fmt.Fprintf(out, "edit\t%d\t%d\t%s\n", e.Range.Pos(), e.Range.End(), written(e.Text))
				}
			}
		}
		fixed := string(source)
		sort.SliceStable(edits, func(i, j int) bool { return edits[i].Range.Pos() > edits[j].Range.Pos() })
		for _, e := range edits {
			fixed = fixed[:e.Range.Pos()] + e.Text + fixed[e.Range.End():]
		}
		fmt.Fprintf(out, "fixed\t%s\n", written(fixed))
	}
	if countOnly {
		fmt.Fprintln(out, count)
	}
}
